card.name: Age or weight unit after a cutoff number
card.fires_on: The unit word (years, year, kg, age) right after an age or weight cutoff number, just before "or older", "and older", "or younger" or "or greater". It appears in dosing and subgroup text.

modes.label: Years after age cutoff
modes.description: The word years follows an age number and comes before an older/younger phrase.
modes.example: give 40 mg orally to patients 75<< years>> or younger and 20 mg orally

modes.label: Weight or age-range units
modes.description: Kg or year(s) after a number in a weight or age range for a patient group.
modes.example: For patients weighing 41<< kg>> or greater, the clinician should consider

card.plain: It fires on the unit "years" or "kg" after an age or weight cutoff, as in "65 years or older".
